questions.history: Tight brackets and one integer binding
questions.prediction: The PR reports the parent parses the name as ext]. Expect failure to bind or execute with only ext supplied. The merge should return [7].
questions.basis: PostgreSQL array brackets delimit the constructor. The literal query fixes the expected value and type.
questions.refutation: The parent returns [7] with tight brackets, or the merge fails or returns another array.

questions.history: Insert a space immediately before the closing bracket
questions.basis: The PR reports that whitespace already terminates the name on the parent. Whitespace between SQL tokens has no bearing on array contents.
questions.refutation: Either revision rejects the binding or reads a different element.

questions.history: With tight brackets on the merge, bind the ordered List.of(7, 2, 7) as ext
questions.prediction: Expect the single row to contain [7,2,7], equal to the array constructed from those three literal integers.
questions.basis: Collection expansion must bind one value per element in encounter order. The repeated 7 makes multiplicity observable.
questions.refutation: Binding fails, an element is missing or reordered, or the collection becomes one nested element.
